title: Nell and the Sock
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3 complete and Phase 4 begins (Learning) — first consonant clusters bl, br, cl, cr, 54-sound stage.
